ui_help.title: HELP
ui_help.home.title: Welcome to the help
ui_help.home.text: Choose a topic on the left or start typing to search.
ui_help.missing_topic: This help page is not available.
ui_help.ai.title: AI ASSISTANT
ui_help.ai.intro: Ask a question about the server. The assistant answers from the help pages. One question per session, one session per minute.
ui_help.ai.timeout: The assistant did not answer in time.
ui_help.donate.title: SUPPORT THE SERVER
ui_help.donate.intro: The server runs on donations from players. If you like playing here, you can help us pay for hosting and development. Every donation is voluntary, and you get in-game bank money for it.
ui_help.donate.reward_text: {mult} times the amount you paid goes to your in-game bank account.
ui_help.donate.event_text: Donations made until {time} are credited with x{mult} instead of the normal multiplier.
ui_help.donate.step_link: Open the payment page in your browser:
ui_help.donate.step_method: Choose a payment method where you can write a comment.
ui_help.donate.step_comment: Write your account name in the comment:
ui_help.donate.step_wait: An admin checks the payment and credits {mult} times the amount to your bank account. You can follow it on the right.
ui_help.donate.no_account: Log in to see your account name and your donations.
ui_help.donate.warning: Write your account name in the comment: the name you registered with, NOT your display name. Without it we cannot find your account and cannot credit the money.
ui_help.donate.history_error: Your donations cannot be loaded right now.
ui_help.donate.history_empty: No donations yet. A new payment shows up here a few minutes after you paid.
ui_help.donate.pending_note: Waiting for an admin to approve it
ui_help.donate.cmd.no_right: You have no right to manage donate events.
ui_help.donate.cmd.none: There is no donate event running.
ui_help.donate.cmd.started: Donate event started: x{mult} for {hours} hours.
ui_help.ai.err_too_long: The question can be at most {max} characters long.
ui_help.ai.err_busy: Your previous question is still being answered.
ui_help.ai.err_per_minute: You can ask one question per minute.
ui_help.ai.err_offline: The AI assistant is not available now.
ui_help.ai.err_overloaded: The AI is overloaded right now. Try again in a few seconds.
ui_help.ai.err_timeout: The AI did not answer in time. Try again.
ui_help.ai.err_network: The AI service cannot be reached now.
ui_help.ai.err_not_configured: The AI is not set up on the server.
ui_help.ai.err_auth: The AI service refused the request (API key).
ui_help.ai.err_blocked: The AI refused to answer this question.
ui_help.ai.err_invalid_answer: The AI gave no usable answer. Try again.
ui_help.ai.err_cooldown: Too many questions. Wait a moment.
ui_help.ai.err_error: The AI returned an error. Try again later.
